name: DbVisualizer
summary: DbVis says anonymous usage data needs explicit user approval, which the first-start wizard asks for. It covers feature usage such as startup time, with no queries, table data or identifying information. A separate 'Report Application Errors' option also exists, and its default is not documented. The update check is on by default, and data goes to DbVis Software AB.

optOut.instructions: Open Tools > Tool Properties > Telemetry. Clear 'Collect Anonymous Usage Statistics' and 'Report Application Errors'. No restart is needed.
